# Furisode

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Furisode
- **Artist / Maker:** Japan
- **Date:** 18th century, late Edo period (1789–1868)
- **Style / Period:** late edo
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 918
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/918
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/fbb6471c-84f1-ae0b-7511-c94c1c217789/full/400,/0/default.jpg

## Extracted Source Palette
`#F8F8F8, #584838, #786848, #987858, #281808, #383828, #B8B8A8, #988878`
